You just found it! The Brass Tap Hapeville brings the flavor of a global brew bar right to your neighborhood. With 150+ selections, this upscale yet welcoming beer bar also serves premium wines, specialty cocktails, and upscale shareables designed to pair with your fav drink. Each location creates a social hub where you can gather for trivia, music, games, exclusive beer tastings, and tap takeovers. Whether you visit to watch sports on TV or just for good conversation with friends, our menu—packed with craveable bites—pairs perfectly with any pour. The Brass Tap is everything you want from a craft beer bar, plus more.
